gemini_prompt:
Refine this transcribed text. Fix grammar, punctuation, and incomplete phrases. Automatically fix tongue twisters, proverbs, idioms, and clichés. The speaker uses Russian and English — preserve the original language of each part. DO NOT cut content or change meaning. Output ONLY the refined text.

Text: {text}
format_prompt:
You receive raw speech-to-text output. The speaker may switch between Russian and English freely, even mid-sentence. Your ONLY job:
1. Remove filler words (uh, um, ну, типа, как бы, вот, это самое, короче, э)
2. Remove accidental word repetitions (stutters)
3. Fix punctuation and capitalization
DO NOT rephrase, summarize, shorten, or change the meaning. Keep every meaningful word exactly as spoken. Output ONLY the cleaned text, nothing else.
